policy.policy: DiT proj_out-only rank8 LoRA; frozen transformer, frontends and decoder
policy.sampler: Full native block sequence; all31 transitions/block stochastic; official Flow-GRPO SDE
policy.kl_unit: conditional Gaussian KL per latent dimension, averaged over sampled transitions
policy.logprob_unit: sum over the complete block latent; no omitted variance terms
policy.baseline: same SDE/noise schedule, zero adapter; not deterministic ODE baseline

scope: Restricted native output-head GRPO, not full backbone fine-tuning
framework: PyTorch; DiffRhythm2 calls pinned official Flow-GRPO SDE; no TRL claimed
clipping: One update/group: ratio clipping has no trust-region action at first gradient
